verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage's own docs say it can optimize and resize images on the fly for any image stored in buckets. Transform options work on signed and public URLs and are supported in the client libraries, so no self-run image pipeline is needed. Delivery runs through the Storage global CDN. Missing for 10: the feature is gated to Pro Plan and above, the specific transform parameters (formats, quality, crop modes) are not detailed in the pack, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve resized or transformed images from storage without running my own image pipeline

citations.quote: Supabase Storage offers the functionality to optimize and resize images on the fly. Any image stored in your buckets can be transformed and optimized for fast delivery.
Image Resizing is currently enabled for Pro Plan and above
Global CDN - Serve your assets with lightning-fast performance from over 285 cities worldwide
